title: Pure Cocoon of Evolution
summary: Weevil Underwood's Cocoon of Evolution and Great Moth evolution build, modernized with Cocoon of Ultra Evolution, Parasite Paranoid, and generic Insect searchers. Instead of waiting six turns on Petit Moth, the deck equips any monster on either field and Tributes it with Cocoon of Ultra Evolution to cheat out high-Level Insect bosses from the Deck.

summary.title: Starters
points: Resonance Insect searches a Level 5 or higher Insect (Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth or Metamorphosed Insect Queen) when sent from the field to the GY, and sends Gokipole from the Deck to the GY when banished.

Gokipole searches a Level 4 Insect (Resonance Insect or Parasite Paranoid) when sent to the GY, or searches the Normal Monster Petit Moth, Special Summons it from the hand, and destroys a monster on the field with ATK greater than or equal to Petit Moth without targeting.
Inzektor Picofalena (Link-2) discards 1 card to equip Gokipole, Parasite Paranoid, or Cocoon of Evolution directly from the Deck to another Insect you control.

summary.title: Opening: Parasite Paranoid + Cocoon of Ultra Evolution
steps: During either turn, activate Parasite Paranoid from your hand as a Quick Effect to equip it to an opponent's face-up monster, turning that monster into an Insect and preventing it from attacking or targeting Insects.

Activate the Quick-Play Spell Cocoon of Ultra Evolution to Tribute that equipped opposing monster (or your own Petit Moth equipped with Cocoon of Evolution) and Special Summon Metamorphosed Insect Queen or Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth directly from the Deck, ignoring its summoning conditions.
During your Main Phase, banish Cocoon of Ultra Evolution from the GY to shuffle an Insect from your GY into the Deck and draw 1 card.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Metamorphosed Insect Queen (2800 ATK) grants all Insect monsters you control targeting and effect-destruction immunity while another Insect is on the field, Tributes a monster at the end of the Damage Step to attack again, and summons an Insect Token every End Phase.
Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth brings a massive 3500 ATK and 3000 DEF body straight from the Deck via Cocoon of Ultra Evolution, alongside classic evolutions Great Moth (2600 ATK) and Larvae Moth.
Inzektor Picofalena shuffles 3 Insects from the GY into the Deck once per turn to draw 1 card, keeping Great Moth and Queen inside the Deck for future Ultra Evolutions.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Cocoon of Evolution equips itself from the hand to Petit Moth on the field, raising its DEF to 2000 and immediately turning on Cocoon of Ultra Evolution.

Corrosive Scales equips to an Insect you control so the opponent cannot attack other Insects, and places Scale Counters whenever the opponent summons or activates cards, reducing their monsters' ATK and DEF by 100 per counter and burning for 300.

allow.Metamorphosed Insect Queen: Modern Insect boss monster designed specifically to be cheated out by Cocoon of Ultra Evolution, granting targeting/destruction immunity to all Insects.
allow.Parasite Paranoid: Equips itself from the hand as a Quick Effect to any monster on the field, turning it into an Insect and allowing Cocoon of Ultra Evolution to Tribute the opponent's monster.
allow.Gokipole: Searches Petit Moth or sends an Insect to the GY to pop a monster and fuel Cocoon of Ultra Evolution's GY draw effect.
allow.Resonance Insect: Searches Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth or Metamorphosed Insect Queen when sent from the field to the GY.
allow.Corrosive Scales: Equips to an Insect to protect it and punishes the opponent for summoning or activating cards.
allow.Inzektor Picofalena: Link-2 Insect that equips Parasite Paranoid or Cocoon of Evolution directly from the Deck.

main: Petit Moth
Classic Level 1 EARTH Insect Normal Monster that Cocoon of Evolution equips to, and triggers Gokipole's monster destruction effect.
Cocoon of Evolution
Equips itself from the hand to Petit Moth on the field, raising its DEF to 2000 to evolve into Great Moth.
Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth
3500 ATK / 3000 DEF boss monster cheated out directly from the Deck via Cocoon of Ultra Evolution, ignoring its summoning conditions.
Great Moth
Level 8 evolution of Petit Moth and Cocoon of Evolution with 2600 ATK.
Larvae Moth
Early evolution stage of Petit Moth and Cocoon of Evolution.
Metamorphosed Insect Queen
Summoned from the Deck via Cocoon of Ultra Evolution; protects all Insects from targeting/effect destruction and attacks twice while generating Insect Tokens.
Parasite Paranoid
Quick Effect handtrap that equips to an opponent's monster to turn it into an Insect, preventing it from attacking Insects and making it Tributable by Ultra Evolution.
Gokipole
Searches Petit Moth (and pops a monster) or searches Parasite Paranoid when sent to the GY.
Resonance Insect
Searches Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth or Metamorphosed Insect Queen and dumps Gokipole when banished.
Cocoon of Ultra Evolution

Core Quick-Play Spell that tributes ANY Insect on either field equipped with an Equip Card to summon Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth or Insect Queen from the Deck, then shuffles an Insect from GY to draw 1.
Corrosive Scales
Archetypal Trap that equips to an Insect (enabling Cocoon of Ultra Evolution) and burns the opponent for 300 per Scale counter.
extra: Link-2 Insect that equips Gokipole, Parasite Paranoid, or Cocoon of Evolution from the Deck to an Insect to immediately turn on Cocoon of Ultra Evolution.
